_note: TUNED from live DOM 2026-06-10 (real episode playing in container Chrome+Widevine — Disney PLAYS; the 2026-06-09 Error 83 was an unregistered device, fixed by relaunching playback once). Player is WEB COMPONENTS (Lit): semantic custom-element tags (toggle-play-pause, play-next, toggle-mute-button, toggle-fullscreen, skip-overlay, ad-badge-overlay, up-next-lite-v1). Playwright CSS pierces open shadow roots, so tag-based selectors are the primary strategy — stable AND locale-immune (aria labels are localized: 'Pausar', 'Silenciar', 'VER EL SIGUIENTE'). Real clickables are div[role=button] INSIDE the shadow root, not <button> elements.
_overlay_note: Lit renders overlay shadow content ONLY while active — inactive ad-badge-overlay/skip-overlay shadow is an empty comment node. So '<tag> div'/'<tag> [role=button]' matches ONLY while the overlay is live: visibility-aware presence without :visible hacks. Bare tags are ALWAYS mounted (ad-badge-overlay spans 1920x1080 permanently) — never anchor a presence check on the bare tag (the stub's [data-testid*='ad'] equivalent trap).

Episode end = boundary_src (blob src swap on autoplay) / ended / runaway guard, all inherited from the shared engine. Page also carries a dummy second <video> (no src) — _VIDEO_STATE_JS already prefers the playing one. Audio: element-level (video.muted=false, vol=1 observed live with sound); mute control aria is Spanish ('Silenciar') so adapter.mute_state() returns None and the 'm'-press net stays idle — element unmute covers it, same shape as Prime.
